name: github-trending
description: GitHub 趋势榜：按语言/时间窗口取热门仓库（API 排序 + 星标增量估算）

language.description: 语言过滤，如 python / typescript / rust

sources.name: trending
sources.code: const token = ctx.getCredential('GITHUB_TOKEN') || process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN; const days = params.since === 'daily' ? 1 : params.since === 'monthly' ? 30 : 7; const d = new Date(Date.now() - days*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10); const q = ['stars:>50','pushed:>'+d]; if (params.language) q.push('language:'+params.language); const u = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q='+encodeURIComponent(q.join(' '))+'&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page='+(params.limit||15); const headers = { accept:'application/vnd.github+json', 'user-agent':'ForgeAPI/0.1' }; if (token) headers.authorization = 'Bearer '+token; const r = await fetch(u,{headers}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status+' '+(await r.text()).slice(0,120)); return await r.json();
